The package installs binaries, desktop files, icons, and license metadata into standard system paths, consistent with Arch Linux packaging guidelines. Dependencies are appropriate for a Tauri application (e.g., webkit2gtk, gtk3). There are no post-install hooks that modify system state beyond file installation.
